title: Reading a sampled posterior comparison
description: You can follow the supplied A/B scaffold without adding its unfinished stopping logic.

steps.description: post_params adds successes and failures to the prior pair. You use the same update expression for either group.
prob_A_better draws from two Beta distributions with a seeded generator. The mean of thA > thB estimates the fraction of draws where A exceeds B.

steps.question: Does this code accumulate observations across repeated batches?
steps.answer: No. It updates from one supplied count pair per group and makes one probability estimate.

steps.description: You see Pr(theta_A > theta_B | data) = 0.0682. The sequential accumulation and stopping rule remain a comment in this scaffold.
